notes: Tax obligation per fixed-asset category (AS_CTGRY leaf categories): category must exist, percentage > 0, no automatic category code, range button (تطبيق) - APP_RULES3_TX, see processes/TX_AS_CTGRY.md

TX_TAXES_AS_CTGRY.CTGRY_CD_ASCT.lov: select m.ctgry_cd_asct || ' - ' || case when app_sec.lang = 'en' then nvl(m.desc_e_asct, m.desc_a_asct) else m.desc_a_asct end d, m.ctgry_cd_asct r from as_ctgry m where nvl(m.leaf, 0) = 1 and m.ctgry_type_asct = :PAGE_CTGRY_TYPE_ASCT order by to_char(m.ctgry_cd_asct)

actions.name: APPLY
actions.confirm_a: سيتم حذف أنواع الأصول المحددة لهذه الضريبة وإعادة إنشائها. هل تريد الاستمرار؟
actions.confirm_e: The asset categories of the range are replaced for this tax. Continue?

params.name: TAX
params.lov_sql: select tax_code || ' - ' || case when app_sec.lang = 'en' then nvl(name_e, name_a) else name_a end d, tax_code r from tx_taxes_types order by tax_code

params.name: FROM_CAT
params.lov_sql: select ctgry_cd_asct || ' - ' || case when app_sec.lang = 'en' then nvl(desc_e_asct, desc_a_asct) else desc_a_asct end d, ctgry_cd_asct r from as_ctgry where nvl(leaf, 0) = 1 order by to_char(ctgry_cd_asct)

params.name: TO_CAT
params.lov_sql: select ctgry_cd_asct || ' - ' || case when app_sec.lang = 'en' then nvl(desc_e_asct, desc_a_asct) else desc_a_asct end d, ctgry_cd_asct r from as_ctgry where nvl(leaf, 0) = 1 order by to_char(ctgry_cd_asct)
